title: Which lines move with the lead on assign or reassign, for all six line types
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order led by technician A with six lines: (1) no technician; (2) implicitly following lead A; (3) explicitly assigned to technician C; (4) status Complete; (5) has logged labor; (6) has an active clock-in with no prior labor.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the six line conditions on the work order.
  2. Reassign the work order's lead from A to B (drag or dialog).
  3. Open the work order and check each line:
  4. - line with no tech and the implicit-lead line moved to B;
  5. - the explicit, Complete, logged-labor, and active-clock lines did NOT move.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The reassignment rules in this story also govern the drag interactions in Story 9.
  • On every path that assigns, changes, or removes the lead, work-order lines move according to the line-movement table (unassigned lines and lines implicitly following the outgoing lead move to the new lead; explicit assignments, Complete lines, lines with logged labor, and actively clocked-in lines do not move).
  • For a work order with mixed line assignments, the line-movement rules are applied to each line independently.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-R1, S4-R8, S4-E5 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “Apply this story’s reassignment rules to the drag interactions in Story 9.”
  • S4-R8: “Apply the line-movement rules below on every path that assigns, changes, or removes the lead technician.”
  • S4-E5: “For mixed line assignments, apply S4-R8 independently to each line.”
